Overview

Jackson is a city in WY with a population of 11,000. Teton Range resort town with world-class skiing, Yellowstone access, and luxury living. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
